1337 Jerome Avenue Affordable Homeownership RFP














          Share
  

 Print 





What Are We Planning for the Site? 

The NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) is planning for development of affordable homeownership and community amenities at 1337 Jerome Avenue in Mount Eden neighborhood of The Bronx. HPD does this planning in collaboration with the community, so keep reading to find out how to get involved! 

This site is part of the Neighborhood Builders Fast Track Initiative. Visit the Neighborhood Builders Home Page to learn more



Site Overview 

1337 Jerome Avenue is an approximately 6,516 square foot site in the Mount Eden neighborhood of Bronx Community District 4. The lot contains a vacant one-story commercial building which most recently served as a City pest control facility until 2013. The building  will be demolished as part of the redevelopment. The site faces the elevated 4 subway line along the Jerome Avenue commercial corridor, in close proximity to the 170th Street Station.  




Project Background 

The City committed to creating affordable homeownership opportunities on this site as part of the 2024 City Of Yes Housing Opportunity citywide zoning text amendment. The site will be developed using HPD’s Open Door program, which funds the new construction of homeownership cooperative buildings affordable to low-, moderate-, and middle-income households.    

The site is in the Jerome Special District with an R8A zoning district and a C2-4 commercial overlay. HPD is exploring the potential for a rezoning to allow the new building  to house as many New Yorkers as possible, while providing space for community amenities along Jerome Ave and ensuring the building’s shape and height are contextual to the surrounding neighborhood.


What Phase of the RFP Process Are We In?  


To read more about the Request For Proposals (RFP) process, please visit the Neighborhood Builders Fast Track RFPs webpage. 









1. Community Visioning 

We want your input on the future of this site! The community visioning phase is your chance to help shape the RFP for the new affordable housing and community amenities. Check out more engagement opportunities below:  

How to Get Involved


Tell us what you think about this future development by filling out the Project Questionnaire by October 16!

Request for Proposals (RFP)

HPD will release an RFP for the 1337 Jerome Ave site to developers selected from the Neighborhood Builders Pre-Qualified List in Fall 2026. Stay tuned for more information!

Please visit the Neighborhood Builders Fast Track webpage for Frequently Asked Questions about the Neighborhood Builders development process.
